doc: A map made outside the game, hosted as a map of its own (docs/port/24-custom-maps.md). Its id is past the client's own table of 898 maps (owner, 2026-11-27: custom maps start at 10000), so the client has no row for it and client_row states the whole row. It states no instance_value: no source has one for an id the game does not have, so the client cannot name it as a destination of its own and it is reached with /tp.
name: Kryta Test Vale

client_row.doc: Every field of the row, because the client has none for this id. The values are the client's own row of map 148, Ascalon City (pre-Searing), measured in build 39167 (tools/client-dll/src/lib.rs, measure_the_map_table), with the world-map place moved from (1062, 684). The name and the description are text of this map's own, in place of a name_id and a description_id of the client's text files.
client_row.name: Kryta Test Vale
client_row.description: A vale made outside the game, served by this server.
